info.description: Local HAL API of the Planejamento Mensal desktop app. Start at GET /api.
info.title: Planejamento Mensal API

tags.description:
Members (contas / cotas): people or cost centres that own incomes, expenses and entries (RF-01, RF-20,
 RF-80).
tags.name: member-controller

tags.description: Spending categories with colour, icon and optional parent (RF-06, RF-07, I18N-07).
tags.name: category-controller

tags.description: Credit cards with finals, holder, default member and closing/due cycles (RF-02 to RF-05).
tags.name: card-controller

tags.description:
Card entries: list with filters, inline editing, rename, restore, confirmation and manual entries
 (RF-40 to RF-51).
tags.name: bill-entry-controller

tags.description:
Review queue: imported purchases waiting for the user to check member, split, category and alias
 (RF-74 to RF-79a).
tags.name: review-queue-controller

tags.description: Imports of Itaú bills: preview, line decisions, confirmation, cancellation and undo (RF-60 to RF-73).
tags.name: import-controller

tags.description: Aliases and the descriptions they group (RF-46 to RF-49, RN-24).
tags.name: alias-controller

tags.description: User settings (IMP-10): thresholds, auto-validation, spreadsheet and e-mail options, language.
tags.name: settings-controller

tags.description: API entry point: the only URL the interface knows (API-07).
tags.name: root-controller

tags.description: Purchases (the fact behind the installments) with the link to their installments (SPEC section 12).
tags.name: purchase-controller

tags.description: HAL profile that documents the custom link relations of the API (API-10).
tags.name: profile-controller

BillEntryModel.description: HAL representation of a card entry (SPEC section 7 fields, section 12 example).

amount.description: Amount; negative for refunds and credits.

displayDescription.description: Alias or override, otherwise the original.

originalDescription.description: Description as on the card; read-only.

cycles.description: Cycles, oldest first; empty for additional cards.

primaryCardId.description: Primary card of an additional card.

CardRequest.description: Data to create or replace a card (RF-02, RF-03, RF-05).

closingDay.description: closing day of the first cycle (used on creation)

dueDay.description: due day of the first cycle (used on creation)

holderName.description: holder name as on the bill

primaryCardId.description: primary card for an additional card, optional

CategoryRequest.description: Data to create or replace a category (RF-06).

parentId.description: parent category for a subcategory, optional

acknowledgeTotals.description: true when the user reviewed a totals difference (RF-64h)

Cycle.description: Cycle of a card, valid from a period.

CycleRequest.description: New closing and due day from a billing period on (RF-04).

EntryEditRequest.description: Inline edit of an entry's purchase (RF-43); null fields keep their value.

ImportLineModel.description: HAL representation of a preview line (RF-68).

matchedEntryId.description: Existing entry the line refers to.

ImportModel.description: HAL representation of an import batch and its preview lines (RF-68, RF-71, RF-72).

dueDate.description: Due date read from the file.

lines.description: Lines, embedded only on the batch itself.

totalDifference.description: Difference between printed and computed totals (RF-71).

LineEditRequest.description: Change of a preview line (RF-69, RF-70); null fields keep their value.

ManualEntryRequest.description: A card purchase entered by hand (RF-44, RF-45).

amount.description: amount of each installment; negative for a credit

installmentCount.description: number of installments, 1 for a single purchase

MemberRequest.description: Data to create or replace a member (RF-01, RF-80).

code.description: short code: 1 to 4 upper-case letters or digits

whatsappPhone.description: phone with country code such as +5551999990000, optional

PatternRequest.description: Description to group into an alias.

originalDescription.description: original description of the same store

RenameRequest.description: Rename of an entry's description (RF-46 to RF-49).

ReviewEditRequest.description: Changes for one or more review items (RF-76, RF-77); null fields keep their value.

ReviewItemModel.description: HAL representation of a pending purchase in the review queue (RF-74, RF-75).

displayDescription.description: Alias or override, otherwise the original description (RF-75).

mergeAliasId.description: Alias of the same store to group with (RN-24).

suggestedCategoryId.description: Category suggested by the alias or by the last use of the description (RF-75, RF-08).

ShareRequest.description: Share of one member, by percentage or amount.
